notes.title: Fantastic Beasts Pack has a new addition - Crab King is now in the game!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/bbd52c096b7e790c48fd26aff98ac8b923dfea93.png[/img]

Hello Bravelanders!

We've been working on the Fantastic Beasts Pack for Knights of Braveland for several months now. The hardest thing to implement were the new bosses, but today the last one of them is finally finished.

A new threat to Braveland comes from the depths of the ocean. Meet the Crab King! Beware of his sharp claws and watch his behavior carefully - some of his attacks may take you by surprise.

With the "Monsters" chapter now fully available, it's time to get the add-on and start defeating the new villains! Buy the DLC and join the battle:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2461900/Knights_of_Braveland__Fantastic_Beasts_Pack/

Tortuga Team.

notes.title: New languages: Espanol, Korean, Japanese
notes.content:
¡Hola Bravelanders!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/b70bd15550e03fb703f89e8a493790edaad4358b.png[/img]

When working on Knights of Braveland, we strive to create an immersive and dynamic, yet comfortable and undemanding gaming experience for our players.

It's unacceptable to force the player to play the game in a language that is foreign to them. That's why today the adventurous world of Braveland becomes even more accessible - we've added Spanish, Japanese and Korean language support to the game.

Update the game and try everything out for yourself. Good luck in battle!

notes.title: Around the World Pack released!
notes.content:
Hello Bravelanders.

We are happy to announce that we have finally released the final planned DLC for our co-op action game Knights of Braveland. It is called Around the World and is dedicated to equipment from all corners of the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/465daa9a8fdbc24b9df60f3a0378628dd5bf8414.png[/img]

The hero of the DLC is Jim from Braveland Pirate. His Dexterity and Perception will help you pass the story challenges, and the starting equipment of the sword and crossbow will be a great help for any adventurer.

New equipment is represented by weapons from all over the world. Tomahawk, katana, revolver, sickle and even the egyptian khopesh. During his travels on all seven seas, Jim has collected an incredible collection and you can experience it in action.

And of course, a lot of hats from many foreign countries. A sombrero, a turban, a beret, a laurel wreath or even a crown will diversify the look of your travel hero.

We hope you'll have a lot of fun with this bunch of new equipment, and Jim the hero from our strategy Braveland Pirate will be the icing on the cake in addition to the rest of the guild knights.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438580/Knights_of_Braveland__Around_the_World_Pack/

notes.title: New bosses released in DLC!
notes.content:
Hello, Knights!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/945a371c035e9bb11dd982ddfdd43db429138dcb.jpg[/img]

Prepare to face new enemies side by side with a new ally. We just released the Fantastic Beasts Pack, an epic DLC for Knights of Braveland!

This new add-on features never-before-seen bosses. You are challenged by the Werewolf and the Ogre, who will soon be joined by the Crab King.

A new character, the Sorceress, is coming to help you against these formidable foes. A very few can match her powerful magic!

There's also a heap of new monster hunter equipment. Try to find these unusual items and figure out the best combinations to use them.

Buy the DLC right now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2461900/Knights_of_Braveland__Fantastic_Beasts_Pack/

Good luck in battle!

notes.title: Update 1.1.3
notes.content:
Hello, Bravelanders!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/18c2f2b6be94c672b48167a41c3383a5917bc951.png[/img]

The new Knights of Braveland update is on its way! Heroes and items from two new DLCs will appear in the game: Around the World Pack and Fantastic Beasts Pack. Keep in mind that the new items are not included in the 100% completion. It means that if you didn't buy the DLC, you can still reach 100% by collecting only the basic items, but after the purchase the limit is extended, and you can continue collecting.

There will be new portraits in the Guild Hall - get ready to meet Werewolf, Ogre, and Crab King, new bosses that will be added soon!

We're also working on the balance of Arcade Mode. You will now be able to buy and pick up food, which in this mode instantly replenishes 5% of your max health.

Thanks to your feedback, we have identified and fixed many bugs. For example, the Guild Leader will now be positioned lower so as not to prevent you from accessing the library, and the Skeleton King will no longer skip his final phase.

Best regards,
Tortuga Team.

notes.title: New bosses coming soon in new DLC
notes.content:
Hi Bravelanders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/053ad8bbc001d3664b638a4b229ef8dd2743a0cd.jpg[/img]

We have great news today! We will soon be releasing the third expansion for Knights of Braveland, the Fantastic Beasts Pack.

With this addition, a new hero will appear in the game, a sorceress who will join your ranks. Get ready to blast your enemies with powerful magic!

The Fantastic Beasts Pack not only adds a new hero, but also brings a whole series of new bosses to the game. Don't worry, they won't attack you all at once - the bosses will come out gradually, after the release of the add-on.

Moreover, the add-on includes additional equipment for monster hunters. These items will help you and your team in the fight against fantastic beasts.

Add to wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2461900/Knights_of_Braveland__Fantastic_Beasts_Pack/

notes.title: Arcade mode added!
notes.content:
Hello, Bravelanders!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/4cf79f9dc29345bc89c4143c85885998dfdacaf2.png[/img]

We're thrilled to bring you the new arcade mode in Knights of Braveland. In this mode you'll be able to test your combat skills by fighting any number of bosses you choose - from one all the way to four! On top of that, arcade mode cuts out the story-driven events, leaving only battles, battles, and more battles to fight. Don't miss out on the chance to have this much fun!

To access the new mode, all you need to do is successfully complete the game on any difficulty level and then talk to the Guild Leader.

The adventures in the world of Braveland continue. Good luck in battle!

[list]
[*] We have improved more than 20 illustrations to be more in one style
[*] The bug when you have started the game and can't go to Main Menu because of broken save file is fixed

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/0daa6246760eaed26aea9b66067d653fbc28b6cb.png[/img]

Hi, Bravelanders!

We have fresh update for you. We have made some tweaks and fix crucial bugs.

[h3]Co-op with keyboard + gamepad[/h3]
You can play local co-op with 2 players using keyboard and gamepad. Earlier you could only play it with 2 gamepads.

[h3]Game difficulty decreased[/h3]
We have analysed game progress of players and easened it for Rookie and Fighter difficulty. New difficulty grade Berserk also added.

[h3]Cloud saves fixed[/h3]
We have detected and fixed the issue with cloud saves. Now you could play on different devices on Steam.

[h3]Achievements progress fixed [/h3]
We have detected bugs and fixed achievemnts Crusher II, Crusher III, Trickster III and Rich III.

[h3]Invulnerability while resurrecting[/h3]
It seems unfair to be resurrected just find yourself under attack of bunch of enemies. That's why we have added invulnerability period after resurrection.

[h3]Player stagger reworked[/h3]
We have detected some issues with player stagger. Now player will have no damage for a short time after being hit.

[h3]Emotes fixed[/h3]
Some strange bug occurs when you use emotes in game. We have fixed faces of heroes so now everything is ok.

Wish you a good play!

notes.title: Roguelite beat'em up is on Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hi, Bravelanders!

Here is our second stream for Steam Fest!

We hope you're enjoying Steam Next Fest and are discovering lots of fun demos, don't forget to come check out our team as we play through our own New Demo! notes.title: Last chance to particpate pre-alpha testing!
notes.content:
Hi, Bravelanders.

In recent months we've been working on our new project, Knights of Braveland, with redoubled vigor. To make the game better suited to the expectations of players, we're sending our fans a test build, a pre-alpha. In this short article we will explain how it helps us and why you should join the testing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/48f4864b326c9582d053def408cb3b0517733e54.png[/img]

For us, the pre-alpha is a great way to see how people interact with the game, what appeals to them, and what causes confusion or irritation. Users reveal problems in the game that we never thought possible! 

Improper balance, bad interfaces, errors and typos. Every little thing in the game should be convenient and understandable to the players, but it is impossible to track all of these little things, especially being a small team. Only with you we can make the game really interesting, fun and intuitive!

For players, the pre-alpha is an opportunity to peek behind the scenes, to see what the game is like when we're not yet ready for its release. Dozens of volunteer testers have already received the pre-alpha, and we regularly listen to their feedback and improve the game based on it. It pleases us to see our brainchild getting better with each series of edits - as if players are already bringing life into it.
But development is coming to the finish line - the release is approaching, and there are fewer and fewer major changes that need to be made to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/57683d8501c13525d66ecf8124c18882b6e25d26.png[/img]

In a few days we will stop sending out pre-alpha and focus on polishing the game - we still have a lot of tedious and unsightly work to do. Optimization, server infrastructure, fixing mistakes in animations and illustrations, working with sound. The list goes on forever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/4952075ec9daa21f47995fba55b5e338e59cd7e5.jpg[/img]

Therefore now is your last chance to participate in the pre-alpha testing, and to see the new game first.
Follow this link and register:
https://www.tortugateam.com/go/kob-subscribe

After that you will only have to wait for the letter with an invitation. Stay tuned for our posts and emails. There will be a lot more good news before the release!

PS: And a short reminder - if you have already registered for the pre-alpha version before August, you need to leave us your email again.

notes.title: Big update of Demo version!
notes.content:
Hello, Bravelanders!

After the Steam festival, we got a lot of feedback from players, and this gave us some ideas on how to improve the game. We weren’t wasting our time and decided not only to rework some old mechanics but add new content too. This is what we will talk about next.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/b01d5b5ae60e9b2bfb6d5e5299eb5d335f90ab4a.png[/img]

The first ideas that came from our players related to making the Hall more lively. Here we decided to add NPCs: neutral characters who participate in dialogues with our hero. The Head of the Guild in the game hall will make it more alive, and will also give us the opportunity to add various atmospheric dialogues with our heroes in the near future. What other characters would you suggest to put in the hall? We'll be happy to read your ideas in the comments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/4f15d78f62cd471727b8404e7589f05341d746aa.png[/img]

The second part of the feedback concerned the leveling of heroes in the hall. In a four-player game, there are not enough resources for all players to improve their stats. Therefore, we reworked the upgrading system to global buffs that affect all squad members. The starting equipment of each hero can also be improved separately, but at later stages. So the balance of costs is shifted towards global upgrades: improving the efficiency of elixirs, sets of random equipment from a blacksmith, the ability to receive tools from a chest, and so on. All this will make our new boss raids more effective, and the way to the main villain will be a little bit easier too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/9cfdf0a82a8305f9148c373c7ad064db92221c80.png[/img]

After studying a lot of Let’s Plays, we also decided to diversify the set of dropped items in the game. Some weapons and gadgets from the main version have been added to the demo.
Let's talk about them a little more:

[list]
[*] Peasant pitchfork is useful not only for close combat, but also to inflict an insidious blow by ramming at several enemies. But keep in mind that your ability to maneuver at time of ramming is somewhat limited.
[*] Throwing knives and axes are effective not only at close range, but also allow you to strike at a distance. This can help out in some tactical situations.
[*] The staff is capable of inflicting damage with the energy of nature. Use it wisely and try not to get too far from Hogwarts.
[*] Traps add some pretty unusual mechanics. Now you can lure enemies into cleverly placed traps to inflict great damage to them.
[*] Pistols are excellent weapons, effective at medium range. Hit a group of enemies with the cloud of your buckshot. Yarr!
[*] And, of course, noticed the flask of flammable liquid. A burning field will cause a lot of trouble to enemies. And that satisfying sound of breaking the glass bottle will bring back pleasant memories of beloved Castlevania games.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/a28899f62934308fce5f443f73a2ac87e9b366b6.png[/img]

And, as a bonus, we will show you the art of another inhabitant of the Hall - the Magician. He will take care of you and your knights. Before each new raid, the Magician will prepare random potions and all kinds of magic bonuses for your adventure. You never know what he will prepare next time, but it will definitely help you in a critical situation. This character will appear in the beta version too, which we will start sending out soon. You can sign up for the beta testing right now and we will inform you when it will be available.

notes.title: Demo has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/79dd623bc659e8b5a7e72fdacff5f789d96eaf0d.png[/img]

Hello, Bravelanders.

It’s been too long since you get any news from us. Because all this time we were busy preparing a demo-version for you. Choose one of four heroes and set off for a hunting on a famous captain Fromm. This cunning villain keeps the whole neighborhood in fear and that’s why the head of the guild of knights will ask you to defeat him. To join the guild of knights you need to pass the test and beat this ferosious bandit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/57683d8501c13525d66ecf8124c18882b6e25d26.png[/img]

You will travel among surrounding lands and pass through portals as a monster hunter, widely known in our circles. In the forest lands, there are countless bandits armed with sticks, axes, bows and even throwing knives, and also some real mercenaries with maces and shields. And, of course, we should mention the sinister wild angry chicken, which can not only viciously peck at you, but also bring down all the power of its weight from the air. Doubt not, in this demo you will have a lot enemies to challenge.

[previewyoutube=g5BmwRrnZz4;full][/previewyoutube]

Don't forget that playing Braveland Knights is much more fun with a friend or even a group of 4 people. We prepared for you both, a real local co-op on the couch, and a full-fledged online mode. However, the online mode is still in the process of being finalized, so please report bugs to the community or on our discord server. The work is still underway and we will gladly correct any bugs as soon as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/c332f0173b758899e0b9e7533fbf0d1098d8ff31.png[/img]

And of course couple of words about our plans. We are currently developing the guild of knights. After defeating bosses, you give all the collected belongings to the guild blacksmith and he reforges all your stuff into crystals. You can use crystals to restore the guild and receive additional bonuses in the next runs. Some may find it unfair that the guild takes so much. But in return, it gives you the opportunity to become a famous hero and restore peace in the surrounding lands, as well as in the distant corners of the Braveland. And a great goal is always worth any cost.

Add our game to wishlist and stay tuned. We'll be sharing development updates and reading your feedback carefully to make the game even better.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253610/Braveland_Knights/

notes.title: Co-op beat'em up in Braveland universe
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/6253b068845faffbc9aaf3e76a6631aa6c2b371b.jpg[/img]

Hi, Bravelanders. 

Here is some news from Tortuga Team. This time, instead of making a dynamic strategy, we decided to create an energetic Beat'em Up or Hack and Slash game. But not only that - we adding a "roguelike" part to it. But first things first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/c332f0173b758899e0b9e7533fbf0d1098d8ff31.png[/img]

After developing of The Spaceland - a turn-based strategy adventure game, we were itching for making something spicey, and we started to play around with some crazy ideas. Like, why not mix Golden Axe/Castle Crashers with something like Hand of Fate? Or, to say it in English - why not try to create a fantasy fighting game with generating campaign? sounds intriguing, right? Well, we too want to see how that will turn out. Especially when developing is already passed one year milestone and our game is beginning to take shape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/4952075ec9daa21f47995fba55b5e338e59cd7e5.jpg[/img]

Once you choose a villain to hunt, you find yourself in a generated adventure. That part is classic. We see a potential prize that we obtain once we move to the next point. But here we can expect either positive or negative outcome from a random events pool.

Picking various story outcomes we can get completely unexpected resutls and even unlock new events. In this way we are able to expand our events pool with unique illustrated mini-stories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/5b755a83892898f8c406e736b6311497c039103c.png[/img]

Combat system is a reminiscent of Castle Crashers and Golden Axe, but focusing more on a classic Braveland enemies, where each of them has its own unique behaviour. As you discovering new Braveland places, more and more tricky enemies will be meet along the way. Some of them are ready to surprise you and even have an ace up their sleeve. For example, why not implement a sand shark? A man can dream :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/0caca25fa19099de984a064f5fe3e7ccec1e090c.png[/img]

But, of course, the most important part is boss fights. They are a cause we go to so called "raids" (generated adventures). Our goal is to collect a unique set of equipment which will help us to overcome a villain in a tense fight. This way we progressing through a story and open access to a new, more malicious villain. But to get to the next boss, we will need to overcome even more dangerous fights with his minions.

On the whole - classic. Except one "but"... We don't have that much of cooperative roguelike games with generated campaign. So we expect better and working hard to create an outstanding fantasy adventure expierience.

Add our game in wishlist and follow, to stay tuned:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253610/Braveland_Knights/
